title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #19

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is tajweed? (1 mark)
   A. Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   B. A type of charity
   C. A kind of prayer mat
   D. The call to prayer

2. Which surah says "Say: He is Allah, the One"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. Al-Kafirun
   C. An-Naas
   D. Al-Ikhlas

3. Which surah has only three verses? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Masad

4. What did the Prophet say about smiling at your brother? (1 mark)
   A. It is a sin
   B. It is a kind of charity
   C. It is forbidden
   D. It is only for the rich

5. Who narrated the eating hadith from the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Hakim
   B. Abu Lahab
   C. Ibn Majah
   D. Al-Bukhari

6. What should we say before brushing? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Amin only
   C. Nothing
   D. Bismillah

7. According to the syllabus hadith, brushing teeth is a means of (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding prayer
   B. Making teeth white only
   C. Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   D. Gaining money

8. Who does the hadith in Muslim say is better and more beloved to Allah? (1 mark)
   A. The tall person
   B. The strong believer
   C. The rich person
   D. The weak believer

9. Which three skills are named in the syllabus hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Cooking, sewing and farming
   B. Swimming, archery and horse riding
   C. Reading, writing and drawing
   D. Driving, typing and singing

10. Which attribute means Allah is free from all faults? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahim
   B. Al-Basir
   C. As-Salam
   D. Al-Malik

11. Which verse teaches that nothing is like Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:1
   B. Qur'an 112:1
   C. Qur'an 1:1
   D. Qur'an 42:11

12. How many pillars of Iman are there? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Seven
   C. Five
   D. Ten

13. Which angels do Muslims believe sit beside every person? (1 mark)
   A. Two recording angels
   B. Four rain angels
   C. None
   D. Ten guards

14. Which angel spoke to the Prophet in the cave of Hira? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Israfil
   C. Atid
   D. Jibril

15. What is the meaning of generosity? (1 mark)
   A. Boasting
   B. Giving freely without expecting anything back
   C. Keeping everything
   D. Refusing to share

16. Which two prophets showed obedience when Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice? (1 mark)
   A. Nuh and Hud
   B. Musa and Harun
   C. Yusuf and Yaqub
   D. Ibrahim and Ismail

17. Who is the last prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Yahya
   B. Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   C. Sulaiman
   D. Isa

18. Why must we clean najasaat before prayer? (1 mark)
   A. It saves water
   B. It is a game
   C. Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   D. It is only for adults

19. What is a mughalladha najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A heavy najasa
   C. A medium najasa
   D. A light najasa

20. Which of these does NOT break wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Deep sleep lying down
   B. Urine
   C. Passing wind
   D. Eating and drinking

21. Which body part is wiped, not washed? (1 mark)
   A. Face
   B. Arms
   C. Hands
   D. Head

22. Why do Muslims all over the world face the same direction? (1 mark)
   A. To confuse others
   B. It unites us
   C. By accident
   D. For sport

23. Which of these can help find the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. A compass or Qibla app
   B. The noise from the road
   C. The colour of the sky
   D. The size of the mosque

24. What is sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Bowing
   B. Standing
   C. Prostration
   D. Greeting

25. How many sujud are in each rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. One
   C. Three
   D. Four

26. What is the tashahhud? (1 mark)
   A. The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   B. A bowing
   C. The call to prayer
   D. The niyyah

27. What should a person do if unable to stand for obligatory prayer because of illness? (1 mark)
   A. Skip the prayer
   B. Pray sitting
   C. Wait until well
   D. Pray later in the year

28. What does the Qur'an say about everything in the heavens and earth? (1 mark)
   A. They are useless
   B. They glorify Allah
   C. They are silent
   D. They ignore Him

29. Which animal is often used to pull ploughs on farms? (1 mark)
   A. Lion
   B. Zebra
   C. Giraffe
   D. Ox

30. What does adornment mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Hiding
   C. Praying
   D. Making oneself look neat and nice

31. What is "income"? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. Money earned from work
   C. Debt
   D. A gift

32. Which verse says "Call upon Me, I will respond to you"? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 1:1
   B. Qur'an 40:60
   C. Qur'an 110:3
   D. Qur'an 112:1

33. When you enter your home after school, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Slam the door
   B. Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   C. Shout
   D. Sleep

34. What do we say when leaving the house? (1 mark)
   A. Amin only
   B. Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   C. Bismillahi walajna
   D. Alhamdulillah only

35. How can children show thanks to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Say thank you and make dua for them
   B. Complain
   C. Compare them with others
   D. Ignore them

36. Which family event should we attend to keep ties? (1 mark)
   A. A wedding or naming ceremony
   B. Only cartoons
   C. Only sad events
   D. Nothing

37. Which qualities of the Prophet did Khadija mention? (1 mark)
   A. He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   B. He is rude
   C. He is careless
   D. He is lazy

38. Whose protection did the Prophet enter Makkah under after Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Khalid
   B. Waraqa
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Mut'im ibn Adiy

39. Who travelled with the Prophet to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Zayd ibn Haritha
   C. Bilal
   D. Ali

40. What happened to Taif later? (1 mark)
   A. Its people accepted Islam in later years
   B. It was destroyed
   C. It never changed
   D. It disappeared

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give three benefits of the Islamic dress code. (3 marks)

42. Write the meaning of the first verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas, "Qul huwallahu ahad". (2 marks)

43. Explain why the Prophet (S.A.W.) is called Al-Amin and how a child can be trustworthy. (4 marks)

44. Describe how to show patience to an elderly parent or grandparent. (3 marks)

45. State three things that nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

46. Write a dua using two of Allah's names and explain why you chose them. (4 marks)

47. What happened to the woman who did not feed her cat? (3 marks)

48. Why did the Prophet (S.A.W.) go to Taif? (2 marks)

49. Explain how Prophet Ayyub (A.S.) showed patience. (3 marks)

50. State the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in your own words. (4 marks)

51. Explain what a Muslim child should do before sharing a message. (4 marks)

52. Explain the rule when you are unsure whether wudhu broke. (3 marks)

53. State two lessons a child can learn from the Prophet's youth. (2 marks)

54. Explain how Islamic cleanliness rules protect health. (4 marks)

55. Write the meaning of the first two verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (2 marks)

56. Explain the difference between a condition and a pillar of swalah. (3 marks)

57. Choose one early convert and explain a lesson children can learn from that person. (4 marks)

58. What must a boy and what must a girl cover in prayer at the least? (3 marks)

59. Write the hadith on brushing teeth given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

60. What does it mean that children are an amanah? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   Tajweed means reciting the Qur'an with correct rules of pronunciation.

2. D — Al-Ikhlas
   These are the first words of Al-Ikhlas.

3. C — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is the shortest of the seven surahs in this lesson, with three verses.

4. B — It is a kind of charity
   A smile that cheers someone up is charity.

5. D — Al-Bukhari
   The syllabus gives Al-Bukhari.

6. D — Bismillah
   Bismillah is said before good acts.

7. C — Purifying the mouth and pleasing Allah
   The hadith says it purifies the mouth and pleases Allah.

8. B — The strong believer
   Both have good, but the strong believer is more beloved.

9. B — Swimming, archery and horse riding
   The hadith says to teach children these skills.

10. C — As-Salam
   As-Salam means He is perfect and free of faults.

11. D — Qur'an 42:11
   It says there is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

12. A — Six
   There are six pillars of Iman.

13. A — Two recording angels
   The Qur'an (50:17-18) mentions two.

14. D — Jibril
   Jibril came with the first revelation.

15. B — Giving freely without expecting anything back
   Generous people give willingly.

16. D — Ibrahim and Ismail
   Both were ready to obey Allah.

17. B — Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   Qur'an 33:40 calls him Seal of the Prophets.

18. C — Purity is a condition for valid prayer
   Prayer is not valid with najasa on the body, clothes or place.

19. B — A heavy najasa
   Mughalladha means heavy.

20. D — Eating and drinking
   Eating does not break wudhu.

21. D — Head
   The head is wiped.

22. B — It unites us
   The Qibla unites Muslims.

23. A — A compass or Qibla app
   A compass helps find north.

24. C — Prostration
   Forehead on the ground.

25. A — Two
   Each rak'ah has two sujud.

26. A — The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   It is recited in sitting.

27. B — Pray sitting
   Islam gives ease.

28. B — They glorify Allah
   All creation praises Allah.

29. D — Ox
   Oxen pull ploughs and carts.

30. D — Making oneself look neat and nice
   Adornment is beautifying.

31. B — Money earned from work
   Income is what we earn.

32. B — Qur'an 40:60
   Surah Ghafir 40:60.

33. B — Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   Say dua and greet.

34. B — Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   This is the dua for leaving.

35. A — Say thank you and make dua for them
   Gratitude.

36. A — A wedding or naming ceremony
   Attending strengthens ties.

37. A — He keeps ties, helps the weak and honours guests
   She praised his character.

38. D — Mut'im ibn Adiy
   Traditional accounts mention Mut'im.

39. B — Zayd ibn Haritha
   Zayd was his companion.

40. A — Its people accepted Islam in later years
   A delegation later accepted Islam.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, dignity and respect, trains modesty and self-control, obedience to Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say: He is Allah, the One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for "Say" and 1 mark for "Allah is One".

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: The people of Makkah trusted him with their valuables because he was honest. A child can keep promises, return borrowed items, and keep secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for two ways.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen without complaining, help them to walk and eat, speak gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Urine, stool or wind; deep sleep lying down; fainting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: "Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, forgive me and have mercy on me", because I need mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name, 1 mark for the request, 1 mark for the reason.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: She tied the cat and did not feed it or let it find food. She was punished because of this. It teaches us that cruelty to animals is a sin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for the punishment, 1 mark for the lesson.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: To invite the people of Taif to Islam after losing Khadija and Abu Talib.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for inviting and 1 mark for the reason.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: He was tested with illness and loss. He did not complain against Allah, called upon Him, and Allah healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the test, 1 mark for not complaining, 1 mark for calling upon Allah.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah is One. He is the Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs. He has no child and was not born. There is nobody equal to Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four verses.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Check whether it is true and kind, and useful and safe. If not sure, do not share, as Qur'an 49:6 says to verify news.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for true, 1 mark for kind, 1 mark for useful or safe, 1 mark for the verse or verifying.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: If you were sure you made wudhu and only doubt it broke, you remain in wudhu, because certainty is not removed by doubt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for staying in wudhu, 1 mark for certainty, 1 mark for the example.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Honest work is honourable, and a person can be good even if poor or an orphan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: They prevent germs and diseases like diarrhoea and cholera. They teach washing hands after the toilet and before meals, and keep places clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Read in the name of your Lord who created; He created man from a clinging clot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: A condition is met before the prayer starts, such as wudhu. A pillar is part of the prayer, such as ruku.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for condition, 1 mark for pillar, 1 mark for an example.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example, Ali teaches that a young person can be brave and truthful for Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person, 1 mark for a fact, 1 mark for a lesson, 1 mark for clear explanation.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: A boy must cover from the navel to the knees. A girl must cover the whole body except the face and hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy, 1 mark for the girl, 1 mark for the general rule of modest clothes.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of the mouth and pleases Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for purification and 1 mark for pleasing Allah.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: A trust from Allah that parents must look after.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for trust and 1 mark for parents' care.
